oneLine: Affirma Capital exits TBO Tek generating $468 million in capital gains

sources.title: Affirma Capital exits TBO Tek with 12x returns, generates $468 million in capital gains

synopsis: Affirma Capital has completed its full exit from travel technology platform TBO Tek Ltd., generating $468 million in capital gains. Affirma Capital originally invested around ₹300 crore in 2018 through a secondary transaction, acquiring a 49.9% stake in TBO before its spin-off from Standard Chartered Bank. Affirma monetised its investment across multiple tranches, including selling a portion to General Atlantic in 2023-24, divestments through TBO's IPO in May 2024, and subsequent block deals and open-market transactions, finishing its final exit between July and October 2026. The investment delivered a 12x multiple on invested capital and a 49% internal rate of return in US dollar terms.
